flowchart.name: Flowchart
examples:
flowchart TD
Node1[Label Text] --> Node2{Decision}
Node2 -->|Option A| Node3[Result A]
Node2 -->|Option B| Node4[Result B]
tips: Node IDs must be single words without spaces
Labels go INSIDE brackets: A[My Label]
Use --> for arrows, -->|text| for labeled arrows
Shapes: [rectangle], (rounded), {decision}, [/parallelogram/]

sequenceDiagram.name: Sequence Diagram
sequenceDiagram.edgeSyntax: A ->> B: message or A -->> B: dotted message
examples:
sequenceDiagram
participant Entity1
participant Entity2
Entity1 ->> Entity2: Message description
Entity2 -->> Entity1: Response description
tips: Define participants first: participant User
Arrows: ->> (solid), -->> (dotted)
Use 'as' for display names: participant U as User
A branch is alt/else/end; every alt needs its end

classDiagram.name: Class Diagram
classDiagram.edgeSyntax: A <|-- B (inherits), A *-- B (composition), A --> B (association)
tips: Inheritance is <|--, pointing at the PARENT: Parent <|-- Child
Composition *-- means the owner deletes the part; association --> does not
Visibility markers: + public, - private, # protected
Generics use tildes, not angle brackets: Repository~T~

erDiagram.name: Entity Relationship Diagram
examples:
erDiagram
CUSTOMER ||--o{ ORDER : places
ORDER ||--|{ ORDER_ITEM : contains
ORDER_ITEM }o--|| PRODUCT : references
tips: Cardinality reads left-to-right: || exactly one, o| zero or one, }o zero or many, }| one or many
Every relationship needs a label after the colon
Entity names are conventionally UPPER_CASE
erDiagram takes NO direction keyword; do not emit one

stateDiagram-v2.name: State Diagram
examples:
stateDiagram-v2
[*] --> Idle
Idle --> Running : start
Running --> Done : finish
Running --> Failed : error
Failed --> Idle : retry
Done --> [*]
tips: [*] is the start and end marker, not a node label
Transition labels go after a colon: A --> B : on submit
A self-transition is allowed: A --> A : retry
Direction goes on its OWN line: 'direction LR', not on the declaration
